name: Koyama Arisa
source:
Arisa is skilled in self-defense in multiple martial arts as well as decent in wielding swords, taught to her by her older sister, Kyoko. Acutely anti-social, she prefers to remain in her comfort bubble with her closest friend, Kiriko, rather than associate with anyone else, and it shows. However, once she warms up to you, you'll find someone just as confused and overwhelmed as anyone else.

Favorite Color: Black
Blood Type: AB-

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/midnightsprings/apocalyptic-dream-18-otome-in-zombie-apocalypse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
